news.title: Project Olive Client Update!
news.subtitle: New custom content and client improvements
news.body: Project Olive Tokens have updated artwork, now stack up to 1,000, and are freely tradable. ThunderNotSoFury has also received its custom appearance and is ready for adventure!

news.title: Quality of Life Hotfixes!
news.subtitle: Less hassle, more adventure
news.body: Molten Core no longer requires rune dousing to progress, and Dual Specialization has been reduced from 1,000 gold to just 50 gold!

news.title: More Project Olive Updates!
news.subtitle: Recent fixes and improvements
news.body: Daily raid lockouts, rotating weekend events, world boss improvements, and numerous server fixes continue to make Project Olive better for everyone.
